metadata.description: The Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp plugin marketplace. Six session plugins that build a complete marketing funnel + four bonus operator plugins.

plugins.name: landing-page-builder
plugins.description: Build and deploy a high-converting landing or sales page — offer stack, the proven 11-section LTO copy structure, a 15-question FAQ, distinctive design via the bundled frontend-design skill, images, and a live Vercel URL. Walks you through it section by section with approval gates. Lead-magnet and full sales-page modes.

plugins.name: lead-magnet-launch-system
plugins.description: Claude Code-native Lead Magnet Launch System. Runs all 8 steps — idea, name, mockup, landing copy, preview, onboarding sequence, promo email, build the asset — then wires the opt-in and delivers. Kit (ConvertKit) canonical; Substack and other providers as adapters.

plugins.name: free-tool
plugins.description: Build a Free Tool — a deployable lead-magnet mini-app (quiz, calculator, assessment, or diagnostic) engineered as an ungameable, shareable research instrument with a tiered opt-in funnel. Builds on the Supabase+SQL storage provisioned by the lead-magnet skill.

plugins.name: lead-research
plugins.description: Enrich opt-in lead lists from organic content into a confidence-rated, research-backed CSV with org/role/contact fields, LinkedIn/X handles, and one-sentence personalized openers. Prefers a connected CRM or paid enrichment connector when present; otherwise uses native web research via parallel agents. NOT for sending or CRM-write automation, NOT for response triage.

plugins.name: email-nurture
plugins.description: Builds multi-email nurture sequences with two arcs: research-nurture (convert opt-ins into booked 1:1 conversations) and Ship 30 FOMO sales (convert a list into product purchases via the proven 7-email framework). Genre-lock preflight, AI-pattern cleanse, a grounding pass against the product's source-of-truth artifact, no-hallucination HOLD shells, verbatim FOMO templates + subject-line rules, plus companion artifacts. NOT for quiz/lead-magnet creation, standalone generic copywriting, or dashboard implementation.

plugins.name: marketing-dashboard-kit
plugins.description: Build a password-protected marketing analytics dashboard end-to-end: discover which platforms you pull analytics from and whether native connectors exist, stand up a safe Supabase data layer with SECURITY DEFINER aggregates, build a dashboard that matches your own design system, and deploy it behind a password on Vercel. Built for the Claude Code Marketing Bootcamp.

plugins.name: voice-lab
plugins.description: Train Claude Code to write like you. Run /voice-training (or any of the 8 sub-skills) to extract your Voice DNA, archetype mix, vocabulary lists, sentence fingerprint, quirks, and tone grid. Compiles into a Voice Template at voice/voice-template.md that every CCMB content skill reads automatically. Based on the Digital Writers Voice Lab by Nicolas Cole and Dickie Bush.

plugins.name: campaign-brainstorm
plugins.description: Dual-mode campaign-planning interview for CCMB graduates. Smart mode reads existing context (CLAUDE.md, voice, MCPs, deps) and asks ~6-8 questions for missing fields. Workshop mode walks 5 framework layers (~15 questions). Produces campaigns/<slug>/brief.md with YAML frontmatter for downstream auto-read. MarTech section is Claude-native — uses installed MCPs/skills, never defaults to paid SaaS.

plugins.name: skyscraper
plugins.description: Scan existing skyscrapers (native skills, Apify, Reddit, YouTube) before vibe-coding from scratch. 5th CCMB bonus plugin.

plugins.name: safe-install
plugins.description: Benevolent shield for npm / CLI installs. Students type `/safe-install <pkg>` and the plugin handles publish-date checks, CVE lookups, lifecycle-hook defang, and version pinning automatically. Reads live campaign status from heymitch/ccmb-marketplace so the shield relaxes globally the moment Mitch flips it off.
